create_FastICA: create a FastICA model to perform independent component analysis on multivariate data
run_fastica_function: run fastica function to extract independent components from a data matrix
test_FastICA_fit_transform: test the FastICA fit_transform method to fit and extract sources in one step
refactor_FastICA_transform: refactor the FastICA transform method to apply the learned unmixing matrix to new data
review_FastICA_inverse_transform: review the FastICA inverse_transform method to reconstruct original data from estimated sources
